senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) heat of the sun, dry heat.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:21">Y. Snh. X, 29ᵇ</cite> top <he>אם ברורה בטל … בש׳</he> whether he meant a clear day with dew or a clear day with dry heat. Y. Sabb. XIV, beg. 14ᵇ; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:5">Tosef. ib. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:5">XIII</cite>), 5; Bab.

<cite ref="Shabbat 106b:9">Sabb. 106ᵇ</cite> <he>בשעת הש׳</he> at the time of dry heat (midday), opp. <he>בשעת הטל</he>. Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ 12; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16">Num. R. s. 16<sup>20</sup></cite> <he>עד שלא בא הש׳ וכ׳</he> before the heat (of noon) came, you flew off (faded).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82">Gen. R. s. 82</cite> (ref. to <he>כברת הארץ</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 35:16">Gen. XXXV, 16</cite>) <he>כבר הבר … והש׳ לא בא</he> the grain was already plentiful, and the rainy season past, but the dry season had not come yet (so that the ground was impassable).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34">Lev. R. s. 34<sup>8</sup></cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ruth 2:14">Ruth II, 14</cite>) <he>שכן דרך … בשעת הש׳</he> for that is the way of the harvesters, to dip their bread in vinegar at the hot time of the day.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16">Lev. R. s. 16</cite> <he>תשעים ותשע בש׳ וכ׳</he> ninety-nine persons die from the effects of heat to one by the hand of heaven.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:33">Lam. R. to I, 6</cite>; a. fr.
